name: Bulwark
description: A shield for everything you publish. Every request is decoded and judged in microseconds by an attack engine with 21 categories and 44 known CVE exploits, scored CRS-style with per-address behaviour, and checked against 250k+ blocklisted addresses; attackers are banned on every tunnel at once. Its own dashboard shows every request in full, warns about waves, graphs the patterns, inspects any IP across a dozen free sources and reports attackers to the vendors that missed them.
author: Alexd Aero

update_card.title: {name} {version}
update_card.tagline: A stronger engine: every attack named and scored, encodings seen through, and an IP Inspector for any address.
highlights: 21 attack categories (SQLi, SSRF, RCE, web shells, IoT…) with MITRE, OWASP and 44 CVEs tagged
Sees through encoding tricks: double URL encoding, overlong UTF-8, %u, look-alikes, entities
SQLi and XSS judged by shape; hits add up CRS-style; probes count only if the app says 404
Catches wordlist scanning, credential stuffing and floods per address, in bounded memory
IP Inspector: RDAP, RIPEstat, Shodan, GreyNoise, OTX, DNSBLs and more, one scored report

actions.label: Stop
actions.confirm: The dashboard, lookups, waves and reports stop. The guard inside Burrow keeps enforcing bans and blocklists on its own.
